name: Sorcerer Polar Sovereign
body:
Some boreal sorcerers are even more attuned with the ancient winters than others. These spellcasters draw their powers not from a kinship with giants or trolls of the North, but directly from the ice and cold of arctic regions. They are born with winter in their blood.

Bloodline

A polar sovereign must have the boreal bloodline (or one of its wildblooded variants).

Frozen Spells

The polar sovereign replaces some of her bloodline spells with the following: frostbite (3rd), winter’s grasp (5th), cold ice strike (13th), summon monster VII (ice elementals only) (15th), mass icy prison (19th).

Diminished Spellcasting

A polar sovereign casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, she can cast spells of that level only if her Charisma score allows bonus spells of that level. This alters the sorcerer’s spellcasting.

Ice Magic (Ex)

At 1st level, whenever the polar sovereign casts a spell that deals energy damage, she changes the type of damage to cold. This also changes the spell’s descriptor to cold. All spells with the cold descriptor are considered to be in the polar sovereign’s sorcerer spell list (but not in her known spell list). This replaces bloodline arcana.

Winter Mastery

At 13th level, whenever she could gain a bloodline feat, a polar sovereign can instead choose to gain access to one of the following witch hexes: hoarfrost, ice tomb, or numbing chillRoWPG.
